title: The Border of Marseille's old port
author: Bram Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Yarrow, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
